title: [Shopify] Store tax lines linked to order shipping charges
summary: Shopify order imports now persist tax lines linked to shipping charges in the existing tax-lines table, with a new action on the Shipping Costs page exposing these details including Channel Liable status.
key_points: Tax lines from Shopify shipping charges are parsed and stored with the shipping line ID as parent reference
Shipping charge deletion removes associated tax lines automatically
New Tax Lines action on Shipping Costs page displays tax information for each shipping charge
Reimport logic uses delete-then-recreate to prevent duplicates or stale records
Currency and field lookups in tax-lines page now resolve through shipping charges
